description.en: Returns a character's "figure" (build/body-size class) value, looked up by base character ID (name string or numeric ID).
Base character ID (a name-hash string or numeric ID) to look up.
The character's figure value; null if the call was invalid or the base ID doesn't resolve to a known character.

example.code:
// Look up a character's figure/build value by base ID
local figure = CMND_GET_CHARA_FIGURE(_baseID);
